dedupe_keys.name: photovoltaic pv solar panel energy generation data

description: Photovoltaic (PV) Solar Panel Energy Generation data is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. This dataset contains voltage, current, power, energy, and weather data from low-voltage substations and domestic premises with high uptake of solar photovoltaic (PV) embedded generation. Data collected as part of the project run by UK Power Networks. Validation of Photovoltaic Connection Assessment Tool The project collected a dataset at domestic sites with Solar Panels. Coverage: UK Power Networks. The publisher named on the listing is UK Power Networks. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
